sql: select id,trigger_type,mode,(debug_snapshot is not null or eval_candidate is not null or controlled_draft_skill_version_id is not null or controlled_draft_skill_digest is not null or controlled_skill_test_version_id is not null or controlled_skill_test_digest is not null or controlled_skill_test_status is not null) as unsupported,exists(select 1 from engine.tool_call t where t.run_id=r.id) as has_tools from engine.run r where public_id=? and tenant_id=? and principal_id=?

select octet_length(control_text) as control_bytes from (select row_to_json(c)::text as control_text from (select r.public_id,r.tenant_id as run_tenant,r.principal_id as run_principal,r.app_code,r.app_version_id as run_version,a.tenant_id,a.principal_id,a.grant_ref,to_char(a.grant_expires_at at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as grant_expires_at,a.resource_digest,a.source_kind,a.origin_authentication_id,a.app_version_id,a.app_version_no,a.root_kind,a.root_id,a.initial_ceiling_sha256,a.accepted_snapshot_sha256,a.admission_decision_id,a.authorization_version,a.operation_id,a.check_version,a.blocked_reason,to_char(a.retry_not_before at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as retry_not_before from engine.run r join engine.run_authority a on a.run_id=r.id where r.id=?) c) q
select octet_length(initial_ceiling::text) as initial_bytes,jsonb_typeof(initial_ceiling) as initial_type from engine.run_authority where run_id=?

select case when octet_length(control_text)<=262144 then control_text end as control_text from (select row_to_json(c)::text as control_text from (select r.public_id,r.tenant_id as run_tenant,r.principal_id as run_principal,r.app_code,r.app_version_id as run_version,a.tenant_id,a.principal_id,a.grant_ref,to_char(a.grant_expires_at at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as grant_expires_at,a.resource_digest,a.source_kind,a.origin_authentication_id,a.app_version_id,a.app_version_no,a.root_kind,a.root_id,a.initial_ceiling_sha256,a.accepted_snapshot_sha256,a.admission_decision_id,a.authorization_version,a.operation_id,a.check_version,a.blocked_reason,to_char(a.retry_not_before at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as retry_not_before from engine.run r join engine.run_authority a on a.run_id=r.id where r.id=?) c) q
select case when octet_length(initial_ceiling::text)<=1048576 and jsonb_typeof(initial_ceiling)='object' then initial_ceiling::text end as initial_text from engine.run_authority where run_id=?

select material_revision,tenant_id,producer,kind,material_id,material_version,payload_sha256,scope_sha256,octet_length(scope::text) as scope_bytes,jsonb_typeof(scope) as scope_type,jsonb_typeof(scope->'parentScopeSha256') as parent_type,case when jsonb_typeof(scope->'parentScopeSha256')='array' then jsonb_array_length(scope->'parentScopeSha256') end as parent_count from engine.material_scope where run_id=? and (kind in ('run-snapshot','run-inputs','run-version-refs')) order by material_revision limit 4
select id,seq,octet_length(type) as type_bytes,case when octet_length(type)<=262144 then type end as event_type from engine.run_event where run_id=? and seq>? order by seq limit 1

select material_revision,tenant_id,producer,kind,material_id,material_version,payload_sha256,scope_sha256,octet_length(scope::text) as scope_bytes,jsonb_typeof(scope) as scope_type,jsonb_typeof(scope->'parentScopeSha256') as parent_type,case when jsonb_typeof(scope->'parentScopeSha256')='array' then jsonb_array_length(scope->'parentScopeSha256') end as parent_count from engine.material_scope where run_id=? and (kind='run-event' and material_id=?) order by material_revision limit 2

select case when octet_length(scope::text)<=1048576 and jsonb_typeof(scope)='object' then case when jsonb_typeof(scope->'parentScopeSha256')='array' then case when jsonb_array_length(scope->'parentScopeSha256')<=4096 then scope::text end end end as scope_text from engine.material_scope where run_id=? and scope_sha256=? and material_revision=?

select material_revision,tenant_id,producer,kind,material_id,material_version,payload_sha256,scope_sha256,octet_length(scope::text) as scope_bytes,jsonb_typeof(scope) as scope_type,jsonb_typeof(scope->'parentScopeSha256') as parent_type,case when jsonb_typeof(scope->'parentScopeSha256')='array' then jsonb_array_length(scope->'parentScopeSha256') end as parent_count from engine.material_scope where run_id=? and (material_revision<? and scope_sha256 in (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)) order by material_revision limit 4097

select material_revision,tenant_id,producer,kind,material_id,material_version,payload_sha256,scope_sha256,octet_length(scope::text) as scope_bytes,jsonb_typeof(scope) as scope_type,jsonb_typeof(scope->'parentScopeSha256') as parent_type,case when jsonb_typeof(scope->'parentScopeSha256')='array' then jsonb_array_length(scope->'parentScopeSha256') end as parent_count from engine.material_scope where run_id=? and (kind='run-state' and material_revision=(select max(material_revision) from engine.material_scope where run_id=68 and kind='run-state')) order by material_revision limit 2
